details:
Currently I am a mod in a group, we have been dealing with a lot of trolls so we have been banning a lot of players.

Some times we will accidently click people at the same time and do a little bit of cross fire and manage to click innocent players as well.

I have been tasked with un-banning people who've been banned by accident and or walked onto screen as I tried to click the troll and got their hitbox by mistake.

What I ask is that to make things easier, please VRC Dev team, you've already got the function but please flesh it out more.

1. Seeing as you can search up player names to ban them, please do the same for the banned player list in the groups. [Currently I have to search page after page after page to find the person to unban them, using Ctrl + F some times works but it has been annoying to look at 100+ pages for 1 name]

Now you seem to have a function if you ban players, the "Ban" button turns to "UnBan" until you leave/refresh the page when you search for players to ban.

1.(a) PLEASE for the love of all that is good, make it so on the "Banned player list" we can also put the names in order from numbers - letters and etc.

That and or allow us to put them users in the banned order, so if we know we got 1 new ban we can just go to the last page and not need to go 100 pages deep for 1 name.

2. Allow moderation teams to leave notes with each ban they've made, currently we have maybe 4k or more bans and we've got no notes for the rest of the team to see, just a name on the ban list and who banned them and at what time.

Sure we can make a discord list, keep track of things that way, tho it is just annoying to have to tab out and or type in vr and miss other things going on in game.

3. Add more options to the moderation screen, I forgot the name of it but it shows a list of players where you can mute them, hide their avatars and etc.

It is a list that shows the user icons and you have options on the right, allow us to be able to have the options for kicking, banning and warning on there too since we could just scroll down that list and click buttons faster then having to click on the player them selves and or enter the Social list.

4. Please add a hotkey toggle for user select so we can select more then one person at a time and or please add a function that allows us to select more then one user at a time, if say we need to ban/kick groups of trolls and or crashers.

5. Please make some QOL changes for moderation, some times it isn't to bad to get into and out of menus if you know what you're doing, tho some times even we stumble doing so.

There needs to be a moderation menu that could be left open if needed, making it a heck of a lot easier to take care of what is needed to be taken care of, since some times going from menu to menu, to menu is slow and or it resets it self and or they shift around once a new player joins and or leaves.

If possible, allow us to have an easier time to keep track of players as well.

5.(a) Like when a user is wearing avatar wise once they joined into the instance, plus what they've been swapping so if they're trying to hide the fact they might of been a crasher or wearing avatars that are racist and are trying to hide.

5.(b) The ability to see at what time a player joined the lobby, since some times we have crashers that join for a split second and then d/c with everyone thus making it impossible to know who did it, tho some times the mod team of the instance might have a member or two who didn't crash.

5.(c) Add some more moderation powers if possible, like being able to hear people from a far, be able to see people from a far, be able to teleport/fly/walk faster then most users, be able to focus on a single user since some times there are to many voices/visuals and said trolls have been known to hide around groups.

Sorry for the long read

ZL
title: Allow group moderation to be a lot easier please.
